behaviors.assignee-options: Opening the Assignee filter shows Anyone, each person, and Unassigned with task counts.
behaviors.search-assignees: Typing a name in the Assignee search narrows the available choices.
behaviors.filter-by-person: Selecting Priya shows only her tasks and respects any active status filter.
behaviors.filter-unassigned: Selecting Unassigned shows only tasks without an assignee.
behaviors.assignee-empty-state: Selecting Ana shows a personalized empty state with a Clear filters control.
behaviors.clear-filters: Clear filters restores all tasks and resets both filter controls to their defaults.

history.notes: The toolbar controls use their unique CSS classes; task headings and dropdown options use visible text. Counts and task names assume the provided fresh seed data.
